newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville offers no surplus power for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville offers no surplus power for Thursday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered no surplus power for Thursday delivery due to low streamflows and the start of fish spill programs, the agency said Wednesday.

On April 10, spill related to the migration of endangered fish species is required to begin at Snake River hydropower project, while spill testing will start at The Dalles dam on theLower Columbia River, a BPA trade source said.
But cooler-than-expected regional temperatures have slowed inflows into the dams, resulting in less water available for flows through power turbines.
For Tuesday, BPA had offered firm power during off-peak hours at $9.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for both Northwest and California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries.
BPA had also offered non-firm power at $9.00 per MWh during hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PDT and at $9.50 for hours ending 0600 and 2300 on Wednesday.
